environments.name: Moonlit Shrine
environments.about: Paper lanterns and quiet stone, under a moon that never sets.

environments.name: Crystal Cavern
environments.about: Humming crystals light the way, and everything echoes twice.

environments.name: Mushroom Hollow
environments.about: Soft moss, tall toadstools, and spores that drift like slow snow.

environments.name: Cloud Library
environments.about: Shelves that float, books that whisper, and stairs made of weather.

environments.name: Sunken Temple
environments.about: Old pillars under green water, with fish for a congregation.

environments.name: Clockwork Tower
environments.about: Brass gears the size of rooms, all ticking slightly out of step.

environments.name: Candy Catacombs
environments.about: Gumdrop walls and liquorice arches. Do not lick the dungeon.

environments.name: Haunted Toy Attic
environments.about: Dusty boxes, a rocking horse that rocks alone, and friendly ghosts.

environments.name: Starship Wreck
environments.about: Tilted corridors, blinking panels, and stars through every crack.

environments.name: Neon Arcade Alley
environments.about: Rain on the pavement, cabinets still playing their demo loops.

environments.name: Data Vault
environments.about: Cold aisles of humming servers, guarded by very polite firewalls.

environments.name: Rooftop Megacity Garden
environments.about: Vines over vents, bees between billboards, the city glowing below.
